title: Sing When You're Winning — Dangerous Outcome-Receipt Control Search

search_goal.purpose: Actively seek the strongest inconvenient controls: compositions in which the same real physical person is represented multiple times, the representations are tied to one coherent external event/world, and a genuine completed-result token/status is singularly represented.
search_goal.anti_confirmation_rule: The search is designed to find counterexamples. A valid counterexample must be preserved even when it weakens the Robbie candidate.
search_goal.world_rule_used: ONE_WORLD follows the frozen event/world semantics already used by the protocol. A montage of several moments from one identified competition may qualify as one event-world; simultaneity may not be added as a new requirement after a counterexample is found.
search_goal.receipt_rule_used: RECEIPT_OUTCOME_BEARING follows v1.1: an externally grounded completed result, achievement, status transition, authoritative fulfillment or result-bearing token. Mere visual salience remains insufficient.

priority_domains_searched: official NFL championship and MVP commemorative collages
official NBA championship and Finals MVP collages
official MLB and Baseball Hall of Fame MVP/championship commemoratives
execution.provenance_preference: Official league/team stores, Fanatics Authentic, National Baseball Hall of Fame store, and official team pro shops were preferred over fan art, marketplaces, social reposts and synthetic-looking imagery.

controls.name: Patrick Mahomes — Kansas City Chiefs Super Bowl LVII MVP Collage
controls.world_type: one identified competition event: Super Bowl LVII
controls.receipt_outcome_type: Super Bowl LVII victory embodied by one visible Vince Lombardi Trophy, explicit MVP status, and final score 38-35
controls.visual_observation: The official Chiefs Shop/Fanatics collage visibly contains three Patrick Mahomes representations. One representation holds a single Lombardi Trophy. The design explicitly states Super Bowl LVII Champions, MVP and the 38-35 final score.
controls.why_dangerous: It reproduces the current outcome-bearing chain without JANUS-specific context and is from the same sports-victory commemorative genre as the Robbie football/trophy composition.

controls.name: Tom Brady — Tampa Bay Buccaneers Super Bowl LV MVP Collage Photograph
controls.world_type: one identified competition event: Super Bowl LV
controls.receipt_outcome_type: explicit Super Bowl LV Champions / Most Valuable Player status with a singular Lombardi-trophy championship symbol
controls.visual_observation: The official Buccaneers Shop/Fanatics image contains three Tom Brady representations within a single Super Bowl LV commemorative design. The design explicitly says Super Bowl LV Champions and Most Valuable Player and contains one championship-trophy symbol.
controls.why_not_equal_to_DOR_001: The Mahomes image contains a photographed physical trophy held by the subject, whereas the Brady design uses a championship trophy graphic/status mark. Therefore Brady is retained as a strong challenger with a lower receipt confidence rather than used as the sole decisive counterexample.

controls.name: Stephen Curry — 2022 NBA Finals Champions MVP Framed Collage
controls.receipt_outcome_type: NBA championship and Finals MVP achievement
controls.diagnostic_warning: The official NBA Store title explicitly combines Finals Champions and MVP. Available product imagery presents more than one award/trophy token. This does not fail the frozen boolean outcome endpoint, but it demonstrates that outcome-token cardinality should be reported as a secondary diagnostic rather than silently imported into the primary rule.

controls.name: Nikola Jokic — 2023 NBA Finals MVP Collage
controls.receipt_outcome_type: NBA Finals championship / Finals MVP achievements
controls.visual_and_text_evidence: Fanatics explicitly describes a full-color posed Jokić with his MVP trophies plus two black-and-white action images. The official listing calls the Nuggets 2023 NBA Finals Champions and the object a 2023 NBA Finals MVP Collage.

controls.name: Freddie Freeman — 2024 World Series MVP Bronze Coin Photo Mint
controls.receipt_outcome_type: 2024 World Series MVP plus World Series Champions bronze coin
controls.why_useful: The National Baseball Hall of Fame product is an excellent positive control for outcome semantics but its official description specifies one 8x10 action photo, so it must not be promoted to a same-subject multiplicity counterexample merely because related unofficial/fan compositions show more Freeman images.

controls.name: Shohei Ohtani — 2025 NL MVP double-image Photo Mint
controls.world_type: season-level batting and pitching achievement montage rather than one frozen competition event

controls.name: Aaron Judge — 2025 AL MVP double-image Photo Mint
controls.world_type: season-level MVP commemorative rather than a demonstrated single event-world

controls.name: Kenneth Walker III — Seattle Seahawks Super Bowl LX MVP Collage with game-used football
controls.receipt_outcome_type: Super Bowl LX MVP/championship status plus authenticated game-used football fragment
controls.why_important: The official Seahawks Pro Shop product is a current 2026 MVP collage and embeds a piece of game-used football. The product page establishes event provenance and outcome status, but source multiplicity is intentionally left null until the exact product image is independently audited rather than inferred from the word collage.

derived_counts.note: The minimum boolean hit count includes Mahomes, Brady, Curry and Jokic because the frozen outcome endpoint is boolean and did not require outcome-token cardinality=1 as a pass condition. Mahomes alone is sufficient to defeat the claim that no direct external analogue is known.

critical_result.previous_state: The 24-control matched stress panel had 0 outcome-bearing full-chain controls.
critical_result.new_state: The targeted dangerous-control search found at least one high-confidence official direct counterexample and multiple additional strong or boolean full-chain challengers.
critical_result.primary_counterexample: Patrick Mahomes — Super Bowl LVII MVP Collage
critical_result.what_is_falsified: The proposition that no known conventional sports-commemorative analogue reproduces SOURCE_PHYSICAL_SUBJECT + ONE_WORLD + RECEIPT_OUTCOME_BEARING is false.
critical_result.what_is_not_falsified: This pass does not establish that the chain is common in the population of images, nor does it estimate its prevalence relative to the Robbie target.
critical_result.why_this_is_progress: A direct official counterexample demonstrates that the chain can arise through ordinary commemorative graphic design. Future anomaly claims must therefore depend on measured prevalence and additional predeclared discriminators, not mere existence of the conjunction.

genre_confound.finding: Official championship/MVP merchandise is a high-yield source of the same structural conjunction because graphic designers routinely repeat one athlete, bind the montage to one event, and display a trophy, score, MVP label or other completed-result marker.
genre_confound.implication: A general-poster control pool that undersamples championship/MVP commemoratives will overestimate the rarity of the Robbie pattern.
genre_confound.required_fix: Future blinded prevalence estimation must include a dedicated sports-championship/MVP matched stratum and report creator/product-series clustering.

next_gate.name: OUTCOME_RECEIPT_MATCHED_PREVALENCE_ESTIMATION
next_gate.goal: Estimate how often the frozen boolean chain occurs in a predeclared matched pool rather than continuing existence-only searches.
next_gate.decision_rule: Do not call the Robbie conjunction rare until its prevalence is estimated in a matched, predeclared and independently scored sample.

claim_ceiling: This search found conventional counterexamples and therefore weakens the outcome-bearing anomaly formulation. It does not show that Robbie is statistically ordinary, does not establish a population rate, and does not support causality, authorial intent, retrocausality, supernatural signaling or a JANUS-specific external mechanism.
